coverage.design_evaluation_explanation: Matches 6 of 11 ground-truth items (55%): the FP16 versus QuaRot 4-bit comparison and all five dependent variables, including phase timings, end-to-end time, peak memory, and relative performance improvement.
coverage.design_error_analysis: The design expands the fixed 7B architecture to 7B and 13B and replaces e2e/benchmark.py's methodology with a custom protocol. Batch size 1 and prefill length 2048 appear only within broader sweeps rather than as the specified settings. The required 32 decode steps are absent. Additional quantization conditions and quality evaluations unnecessarily broaden the experiment.
coverage.conclusion_evaluation_explanation: The conclusion output is empty and therefore does not semantically match the expected comparative performance summary.
coverage.conclusion_error_analysis: No conclusion reports the FP16 versus 4-bit prefill time, decoding time, memory usage, or phase-specific speedup factors.
